notes.title: 4.1.2 - Achievement Fixes
notes.content:
Fixes 


 Fixed all medals type achievements not unlocking correctly. *
 Mixeroid handling improved.
 Mixeroid is restricted to gameplay bounds and will no longer self-destruct.
 Mixer Survival scoring system changed to make criterion more obvious.


* If criteria already met achievements may not unlock. This will be fixed in the next build.

notes.title: Wireless Controller Fixes
notes.content:
Version 3.1.2 Fixes:


    Fixes some issues with Wireless Controllers
    Added button to clear Mixer authorization and regenerate Mixer code

notes.title: Version 2.1.12
notes.content:
Fixes 

Leaderboard no longer overflows UI.
Leaderboard paging now works.
Global leaderboard now works.
Achievements now track progress correctly.
Possible fix for wireless controllers.
